summary: Sync lldap door codes to the lock and Alarmo
description: Pushes the door-code attribute of every door_access member in lldap to Lock Code Manager (Z-Wave lock) and Alarmo, and removes the codes of users it added once they leave the group.

lldap_user.description: lldap user in lldap_strict_readonly (its password comes from 1Password)

group.description: Only members of this lldap group get a code; empty for everyone

lcm_entry.description: Title of the Lock Code Manager config entry to manage

dry_run.description: Report what would change without changing anything
